# Current-source isolated agent hosts

## Prospective contract

R4 adoption maintenance against `c7e6d44`, under ADR-0011/0020/0072 and
I8/I13/I15/I17/I18. The earlier September21 host results cannot identify today's
binary. Refresh actual model-host proof without modifying installed binaries,
registrations, global guidance, consumer repositories, dependencies or services.
This is an explicit MCP task, not proof of automatic project-instruction loading.

Freeze the committed source archive, candidate binary, kit documentation, synthetic
index, collector, prompt, launcher and verifier before acquisition. The isolated
kit root has no purchased corpus. One authored HTML fixture exercises the normal
commercial-source adapter without sending purchased code to a model. The MCP child
receives a minimal `env -i`; hosts use existing authentication directly, with an
allowlisted process environment and invocation-local configuration. Auth/cache
bookkeeping is not asserted absent. Neither run bypasses host policy.

Nine sequential calls: intent → compatible capability search → guarded exact
capability → guarded quality list → deliberately stale quality lookup → correct
same-session lookup → contribution guide → synthetic source search → exact source.
The wrong catalog revision must be refused without protected payload. Recovery
uses the already-observed current revisions; this does not authorize auto-accepting
changed metadata in an adopter. Compare actual recorded arguments/results to an
independent SDK run, additionally checked against source docs/catalog/inventory
and known fixture bytes. Process exit or the model's summary alone is insufficient.

Budget: one Codex Sol/low and one Claude Haiku acquisition, each capped at 180 seconds
and 2 MiB per output stream. One diagnosed harness correction is allowed; retain the
original inputs/failed result before any corrected acquisition. No repeated trials
to select a favorable response. Offline synthetic verifier canaries must fail on
missing/altered calls, dropped guards, masked refusal, wrong body, unexpected tools
or missing recovery. Replaying a retained trace invokes no model or network.

Stop at this evidence boundary. Real consumer setup, installed-binary identity,
automatic instruction loading, general host reliability, UI quality and G1/G4
acceptance remain separate. Acquisition packet:
`/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-host-current.Uh3VanNH`. The initial preparation-only packet
`/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-host-current.MC7c5rr1` is retained; pre-acquisition review
added symlink refusal and collector-time identity checks before any host trial.

## Results

| Acquisition | Observed result | Elapsed |
|---|---|---:|
| SDK reference / executable probe | nine reference calls pass; separate 22-tool probe verifies current metadata, three routed guides, refusals and recovery | local deterministic checks |
| Claude Code 2.1.280 / Haiku 4.5 | **9/9 pass**, including the expected stale refusal, recovery and exact synthetic source |37.649s |
| Codex 0.155.1 / Sol-low, original prompt | **failed: 4/9**, natural exit 0; reported missing revision fields despite both fields in its recorded response |46.061s |
| Codex 0.155.1 / Sol-low, explicit JSON-field mapping | **failed: 8/9**, natural exit 0; refusal/recovery observed, then reported source-response parsing trouble before exact get |113.343s |

The two Codex failures stay failures. Both response representations contain the
revision fields; source search returns one `results` entry with all four exact
variant axes. The model reports local processing failures, but the retained host
JSONL does not include that processing code. **Root cause is not established.**
No server change is justified by the narration alone. The single bounded prompt
comparison changes neither model, oracle, binary, isolation nor acceptance. No
third acquisition or model escalation was attempted.

All three host processes exit 0 naturally, drain both streams, preserve captured
input/executable hashes, and require no forced cleanup. No unexpected tools were
observed. Claude declares only the appkit MCP connected, no built-in tools, its
host-provided telemetry plugin and no permission denials; the trial does not claim
all host plugins or incidental auth/cache/network activity were absent. Claude
reports $0.0788986 for this single trial, not a general cost benchmark.

The offline verifier was frozen before acquisition. Before freezing, actual
historical Claude output exposed its JSON-envelope representation; comparison
accepts that envelope only if it exactly duplicates the structured result, which
must still match the SDK oracle. Post-acquisition canaries preserve Codex's
exit0/partial-call failure and its `status=failed,error=null` MCP-error encoding;
recognizing the latter cannot make either incomplete trace pass. Source and
document byte checks, guards and the nine-call requirement remain unchanged.
All 19 offline verifier tests pass; retained traces still accept Claude and reject
both incomplete Codex runs. The full MCP package passes the race detector. These are runtime/package results,
not broader host reliability, consumer adoption or quality-gate promotion.

## Reproduce and resume

[Fixture instructions](fixtures/host-current/README.md) separate cheap offline
replay from opt-in model acquisition. Retained v1 and field-mapped v2 launchers
remain under the private packet's `fixtures/`; prompts, configs, traces, reference
oracle, input manifests and lifecycle records are retained per run. Only synthetic
component source entered provider context; no installed registrations or consumer files
were changed. This archive build reports `devel` without embedded VCS identity;
the archived source revision and binary SHA below identify it instead.

Next Codex work should select one bounded response-unwrapping diagnosis, not repeat
the same nine-call trial hoping for a pass. Inspect actual host processing if the
host can expose it, or compare its supported invocation-local tool presentation
with unchanged MCP bytes. Require a new prospective budget; no global feature
change, alternate server protocol, model upgrade or consumer mutation is authorized
by this assessment. Keep automatic instruction loading and real app tasks separate.
